Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Raid Buff Off (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Cancel selected buffs during combat in selected areas.
Description: Global client. Cancel checked PvE raid buffs during combat in checked Ultimate raids, or enable the optional all-area testing checkbox. Three-column English job headings are always expanded. Starry Muse is excluded. DTR raidbuff: left-click ON/OFF, right-click settings. Open /rbo. Defaults OFF with empty selections; all-area testing defaults OFF.
Changelog: 0.1.3.0: Replace collapsible job headers with static English titles. Remove Pictomancer/Starry Muse and prune its old selection. Add an optional all-area test checkbox; master ON, combat, character readiness and selected-buff requirements still apply. Testing is OFF by default.
